heroes.headline: Cyclone Akvan makes landfall in eastern India
heroes.body: Severe storm crosses near Gopalpur with gusts 90-100 mph; 300,000+ evacuated, 423 rescue teams deployed, schools shut across coastal districts.

heroes.headline: Russia fires wave of ~30 ballistic missiles at Kyiv
heroes.body: Seven overnight waves hit energy and transport sites; fires burn in three districts, Dutch and Austrian embassies damaged, at least three killed.

heroes.headline: COP31 reaches its final day in deadlock
heroes.body: Closing draft omits fossil-fuel phase-out while $120bn adaptation finance stays unresolved; hosts push a '35 by 35' clean-power goal.
heroes.claim: UN CLIMATE SUMMIT · UN News, Reuters
